Active pairs each consume two row-layer incidences, giving 2|A|≤k|S|; collision-core points lie in deterministic W_A.

theorem layeredNeighbors_erase_card {I V : Type*} {k : ℕ}
    (f : I → Fin k → V) (S : Finset I) {z : I} (hz : z ∈ S) :
    (layeredNeighbors f S).card + (collisionLayers f S z).card =
      (layeredNeighbors f (S.erase z)).card + k
nodes.proof_route: Express neighbor set as old neighbors union the k distinct neighbors of removed row. Their intersection is an injective image of collisionLayers. Apply card_union_add_card_inter.

theorem layeredNeighbors_expansion_of_peeling {I V : Type*} {d k : ℕ}
    (f : I → Fin k → V) (S : Finset I)
    (h : ∀ T ⊆ S, T.Nonempty → ∃ z ∈ T, (collisionLayers f T z).card < d) :
    (k + 1) * S.card ≤ (layeredNeighbors f S).card + d * S.card
nodes.proof_route: Strong induction on finite row sets. Choose a low-collision row, invoke induction on its erase, and combine exact removal identity with κ<d by natural arithmetic.

    ∃ T ⊆ S, T.Nonempty ∧ ∀ z ∈ T, d ≤ (collisionLayers f T z).card
nodes.proof_route: Contrapositive of peeling: failure forbids the statement that every nonempty subset has a low-collision row.

    (s : Forms g.F d k) (S : Finset (Fin (rowCount d n))) :
    neighbors (preliminary g s) S =
      layeredNeighbors (fun z i => address g s i (g.rowOrder z)) S

    ∃ S : Finset (Fin (rowCount (dimension ε) n)),

      ∀ z ∈ S, dimension ε ≤
        (collisionLayers (fun z i => address g s i (g.rowOrder z)) S z).card

      activeLayers g (preliminaryActivePairs g s S) (g.rowOrder z)

theorem uniformProb_candidateCollision_le {F : Type*} [Field F] [Fintype F]
    {d : ℕ} (W : Finset (Fin d → F)) :
    uniformProb (candidateCollision W) ≤ (W.card : ℝ) ^ 2 / (Fintype.card F : ℝ) ^ 2
nodes.proof_route: Union bound ordered pairs from deterministic candidate set W. For distinct pairs, exact two-linear-functional collision probability equals q⁻²; for diagonal pairs the event is false. Count at most |W|² pairs.

theorem uniformProb_exists_active_sets_le_pow {d n k : ℕ} (g : Geometry d n)
    (hk : k ≤ fieldSize d n) (a : ℕ) (B : ℝ)
    (hbase : (k : ℝ) * (a : ℝ) ^ (2 * d) / (fieldSize d n : ℝ) ≤ B) :
    uniformProb (fun s : Forms g.F d k =>
      ∃ A ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin k × g.F)).powersetCard a,
        activeWitnessEvent g A s) ≤ B ^ a

          (fieldSize (dimension ε) n : ℝ))

theorem preliminary_expansion_limit (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε ∧ ε < 1 / 2)
    (g : ∀ n, Geometry (dimension ε) n) :
    Tendsto (fun n =>
      uniformProb (fun s : Forms (g n).F (dimension ε) (arity ε) =>
        ¬ PreliminaryGood ε n (g n) s) * (n : ℝ) ^ (1 / ε))
      atTop (nhds 0)

Root proved this upper bound tends to zero, so squeeze_zero' gives the exact canonical limit uniformly in arbitrary public Geometry and rowOrder.
